description: How can I draw charts or diagrams in MetaList, with a valid Mermaid source example?

conversation.content: Do you know how I can draw charts or diagrams in MetaList? Please show an example of the text-based option.

criteria.instruction: Explain the supported Excalidraw and Mermaid options faithfully to the reference facts without unsupported claims or claimed execution.

Show the literal Mermaid source inside a four-backtick outer code fence, with the inner triple-backtick Mermaid fence and outer fence both closed before subsequent prose. A direct Mermaid fence would render the diagram instead of showing its source, and an equal-length nested triple-backtick fence is invalid.

expectation.reference_facts: Excalidraw provides editable hand-drawn diagrams through Add Excalidraw diagram. A note tagged @markdown renders a fenced mermaid block as a local responsive SVG in view mode. Mermaid source remains ordinary stored note text, stays searchable, and can enter AI note context when that note is otherwise permitted; Excalidraw's hidden embedded-text limitation does not apply. In AI chat a direct mermaid fence renders the diagram, so a help answer that teaches the source must wrap the literal triple-backtick mermaid block in an outer fence of four backticks and put all later prose outside that closed outer fence.
